```{r}
library(rstanarm)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidybayes)

# ── FIT BAYESIAN MODEL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Weakly informative priors (default in rstanarm — appropriate here)
# This will take 2-5 minutes to sample 4 chains × 2000 iterations

cat("Fitting Bayesian logistic regression...\n")

bayes_model <- stan_glm(
  y ~ mean_dist_to_gene + mean_local_density + mean_gene_length +
      scaffold_chr_length_dup1 + either_opsin,
  data   = model_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior  = normal(0, 2.5),          # weakly informative
  prior_intercept = normal(0, 10),
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 2000,                     # 1000 warmup + 1000 sampling per chain
  seed   = 42,
  cores  = parallel::detectCores()   # sample chains in parallel
)

cat("Done sampling.\n")
summary(bayes_model)
```



```{r}
# ── BAYESIAN PLOTS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
posterior <- as.matrix(bayes_model)
param_names <- c("mean_dist_to_gene", "mean_local_density", "mean_gene_length",
                 "scaffold_chr_length_dup1", "either_opsinopsin")
param_labels <- c("Distance to nearest gene", "Local gene density",
                  "Gene length", "Scaffold size", "Either gene is opsin")

# ── PLOT 1: Traceplots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_trace <- mcmc_trace(
  as.array(bayes_model),
  pars = param_names,
  facet_args = list(labeller = labeller(parameter = setNames(param_labels, param_names)),
                    ncol = 1)
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff6b6b","#4ecdc4","#ffe66d","#58a6ff")) +
  labs(title    = "MCMC Traceplots",
       subtitle = "Healthy chains show random mixing ('hairy caterpillar') with no trends or divergences") +
  theme_hydra +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(color = "#c9d1d9", size = 8))

# ── PLOT 2: Posterior Distributions ───────────────────────────────────────────
p_posterior <- mcmc_areas(
  posterior,
  pars = param_names,
  prob = 0.89,          # 89% credible interval (common Bayesian choice)
  prob_outer = 0.95
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#ffe66d", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = rev(param_labels)) +
  labs(title    = "Posterior Distributions (log-odds scale)",
       subtitle = "Shaded = 89% credible interval; dashed line = zero effect") +
  theme_hydra

# ── PLOT 3: Credible Intervals vs Frequentist CIs ─────────────────────────────
# Extract posterior credible intervals
bayes_ci <- as_tibble(posterior[, param_names]) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "sample") %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    mean   = mean(sample),
    lo89   = quantile(sample, 0.055),
    hi89   = quantile(sample, 0.945),
    lo95   = quantile(sample, 0.025),
    hi95   = quantile(sample, 0.975),
    p_dir  = mean(sample > 0),   # probability of direction
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    term_clean = recode(term, !!!setNames(param_labels, param_names)),
    method = "Bayesian"
  )

freq_ci <- tidy(full_model, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term %in% param_names) %>%
  mutate(
    term_clean = recode(term, !!!setNames(param_labels, param_names)),
    lo95 = conf.low, hi95 = conf.high, mean = estimate, method = "Frequentist"
  ) %>%
  select(term, term_clean, mean, lo95, hi95, method)

p_compare <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6e7681") +
  # Frequentist 95% CI
  geom_errorbar(data = freq_ci,
                aes(x = term_clean, ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95, color = method),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, position = position_nudge(x = 0.15)) +
  geom_point(data = freq_ci,
             aes(x = term_clean, y = mean, color = method),
             size = 3.5, position = position_nudge(x = 0.15)) +
  # Bayesian 95% CI
  geom_errorbar(data = bayes_ci,
                aes(x = term_clean, ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95, color = method),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)) +
  geom_point(data = bayes_ci,
             aes(x = term_clean, y = mean, color = method),
             size = 3.5, position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Bayesian" = "#ff6b6b", "Frequentist" = "#4ecdc4"),
                     name = NULL) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title    = "Bayesian vs Frequentist Coefficient Estimates",
       subtitle = "Points = mean/estimate; bars = 95% CI / credible interval",
       x = NULL, y = "Coefficient (log-odds)") +
  theme_hydra +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# ── PLOT 4: Posterior Predictive Check ────────────────────────────────────────
p_ppc <- pp_check(bayes_model, nreps = 100, plotfun = "stat",
                  stat = "mean") +
  labs(title    = "Posterior Predictive Check",
       subtitle = "Simulated outcome means (light) vs observed mean (dark)\nGood fit = observed falls within simulated distribution") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4ecdc4", "#ff6b6b")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#4ecdc4", "#ff6b6b")) +
  theme_hydra

# ── PLOT 5: Opsin Posterior in Detail ─────────────────────────────────────────
opsin_samples <- tibble(sample = posterior[, "either_opsinopsin"])
p_opsin_post <- ggplot(opsin_samples, aes(x = sample)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = after_stat(x) > 0),
                 bins = 80, color = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#ffe66d", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(opsin_samples$sample),
             color = "#ff6b6b", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x    = mean(opsin_samples$sample) + 0.05,
           y    = Inf, vjust = 2, hjust = 0,
           label = sprintf("Mean = %.2f\nP(β > 0) = %.1f%%",
                           mean(opsin_samples$sample),
                           mean(opsin_samples$sample > 0) * 100),
           color = "#ff6b6b", size = 3.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4ecdc4", "TRUE" = "#ff6b6b"),
                    labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative (non-TD)", "TRUE" = "Positive (TD)"),
                    name   = "Effect direction") +
  labs(title    = "Posterior Distribution: Opsin Effect",
       subtitle = "What fraction of posterior mass falls above zero?",
       x = "β (log-odds of TD | opsin gene)", y = "Count") +
  theme_hydra

# ── SAVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("bayes_traceplots.png",     p_trace,      width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 200, bg = "#0d1117")
ggsave("bayes_posteriors.png",     p_posterior,  width = 8,  height = 6,  dpi = 200, bg = "#0d1117")
ggsave("bayes_vs_freq.png",        p_compare,    width = 9,  height = 6,  dpi = 200, bg = "#0d1117")
ggsave("bayes_ppc.png",            p_ppc,        width = 7,  height = 5,  dpi = 200, bg = "#0d1117")
ggsave("bayes_opsin_posterior.png",p_opsin_post, width = 8,  height = 5,  dpi = 200, bg = "#0d1117")

cat("All Bayesian plots saved.\n")
```
